title: Football: Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang puts Marseille back on track in Ligue 1
summary: Marseille have climbed back into the top three of Ligue 1, pending the outcome of LOSC's match, thanks to goals from Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang, Igor Paixao and Hamed Traoré. Marseille have also opened up a three-point lead over Monaco following the latter's heavy defeat to PFC.
